question: Kathak guru, Shovana Narayan received the _____ in 1992.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Padma Shri.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ​An established **Kathak dancer from India **is **Shovana Narayan.**
 
• She works for the** Indian Audit and Accounts Service **as a **career officer.**
 
• She performs both **domestically and abroad.**
 
• In **1992,** she received the** Padma Shri honor. **
 
• Her mentor was** Birju Maharaj.​​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Padma Bhushan:**

 
 
• **The third-highest civilian honor **in the Republic of India is the Padma Bhushan.
 
• It was established on **January 2nd, 1954.**
 
• The** Indian Prime Minister **appoints the **Padma Awards Committee** each year.
 
• Between **May 1 and September 15**, submissions for the prize are accepted.
 
• **Twenty-three recipients** of the Padma Bhushan were honored when it was first established in 1954.
 
• The Padma Bhushan was given to **seventeen persons in 2022.​**
 
 
 
• **Nritya Shiromani:**
 
 
• An** annual honor** is the National Nritya Shiromani Award.
 
• It is presented to internationally **renowned musicians and dancers** in recognition of their contributions to the arts.
 
 
 
• **Padma Vibhushan:**
 
 
• After the Bharat Ratna, the Padma Vibhushan is the **Republic of India's second-highest civilian honor.**
 
• It was established on** January 2, 1954.**
 
• **Satyendra Nath Bose, Nand Lal Bose, Zakir Hussain, Balasaheb Gangadhar Kher, Jigme Dorji Wangchuck, and V. K. Krishna Menon** were the inaugural recipients of the prize, in 1954.
 
• **Four people **received the most recent Padma Vibhushan Awards,** two of them** were posthumous.
 
 

128:T1
